payload.title: Prepare Gitea annotation packet
payload.description: Evaluate go-gitea/gitea at pinned commit 0b1067484fcdc497dc34d9113c467182231e6ea9 as a Go identity, user-profile, and access-token corpus candidate. Verify repository identity and license, choose a manageable complete scope around models/auth/access_token.go and modules/structs/user.go, inventory every included file and exclusion, and prepare scanner-independent proposed annotations for applicable layers. Include positives, realistic negatives, ambiguities, evidence context, rationale, and provenance. Unsupported Go scanning must later report unread rather than a clean negative. Keep all annotations proposed pending human review.
